key_insight: PPMem gives a video world model persistent 3D memory using compact, oriented planes. Each plane uses just 7 parameters to represent major scene structures such as walls, floors, and facades.
problem_solved: Video world models need to remember previously generated environments as they explore, rather than relying only on transient video context.
method: Use plane primitives as persistent 3D memory for the generated environment.
Represent dominant indoor and outdoor structures with a compact set of oriented planes, each described by 7 parameters.
Augment a video diffusion transformer with this memory approach; the supplied abstract is truncated before further architectural details.
impact: Compact geometric memory offers a promising way to support persistent environments in video generation. The supplied excerpt does not include results establishing improvements in consistency, efficiency, or scale.
